method.teacher_system: The teacher guides participants to close their eyes and follow their breath, then leads them through a sequence of chakra-focused visualizations and improvised movements starting from the root chakra.
method.signature: Guided introspective dance journeys through the seven chakras using vivid visual imagery and inner body sensations.

practices.what: Softly close your eyes, follow your breath, relax, and let go into wherever the chakras take you.
Feel your connection with Mother Earth and the warmth of an ancient campfire as you move your feet.
Imagine a soft glow from a luminous full moon awakening your feminine energy and cleansing your lower belly.
Imagine yourself warmed by the sun, activating your solar plexus with golden light and fiery masculine energy.
Tune into the beat of your heart, the key to love, and feel the presence of an angel helping you release heaviness.

beliefs.belief: Dancing is an inner journey of self-discovery and connection to energy centres.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner to an inner journey of self-discovery.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling connected to their own inner energy and deeply at ease in their dance.

struggles.theme: Dancing outside and feeling self-conscious about neighbors seeing
Trouble sitting to meditate, but chakra dance works
Ads interrupting the peaceful flow of the practice

clicked.theme: Closing eyes and avoiding self-judgment made the experience amazing
Music syncing with the chakras made it magical and emotional

requests.theme: Asking for videos without commercial interruptions

meant.theme: Brought tears of release, centering, and deep emotional healing
Felt deeply connected to body, mind, soul, and feminine power
Provided a powerful, life-changing meditation and spiritual journey

method.limits: The video shows guided interpretive group dancing with voiceover instructions, so specific technical footwork breakdowns cannot be observed.
